{
    "content": "<p>This can be useful when you need a file to be right off the root of your\nInternet facing site - files like robots.txt, sitemap.xml, or the verification\nfile for Google Webmaster tools. We'll take advantage of PowerShell's ability to\nuse any .NET methods along with the Files collection on each SPWeb in\nSharePoint.\n<code>$fileBytes = [system.io.file]::ReadAllBytes(&quot;c:\\the\\full\\path\\to\\your\\file.txt&quot;); $site = Get-SPSite &quot;http://yourdomain:portifneeded&quot;; $site.RootWeb.Files.Add(&quot;file.txt&quot;, $fileBytes, $true);</code>\nThis will result in a file.txt located at\n&quot;http://yourdomain:portifneeded/file.txt&quot;. Sweet!</p>\n",
